tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search cheap flights between two airports or cities and return the cheapest all-in fare plus a cheapest-sensible alternative (penalises 20h+ layovers and risky overnight transfers). Compares live fares and cached data where available, expands nearby airports and combines self-transfer one-ways when

tools.name: explore_cheap_destinations
tools.description: Where can I fly cheaply from here? Lists the cheapest destinations from an origin for a month, optionally under a budget. Example: {"origin":"ABJ","month":"2026-12","budget":400,"currency":"EUR"}.

tools.name: find_cheapest_dates
tools.description: Cheapest known fare for each day of a month on one route: a price calendar to pick the cheapest day to fly. Example: {"origin":"DSS","destination":"LIS","month":"2026-12","currency":"EUR"}. Prices may be cached (priceKind indicative); confirm with search_flights before booking.

tools.name: get_flight_offer
tools.description: Full details of one offer from search_flights: legs, segments, layovers, baggage, fees and warnings. Example: {"id":"off_8f2c1a"}. Offers expire about 30 minutes after the search.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Booking link for an offer: bookingLink is a lowest.flights redirect that picks a bookable partner and attributes the click to your agent; alternatives list other partners. Includes self-transfer and cached-price warnings to show the traveller. Example: {"id":"off_8f2c1a"}.

tools.name: list_flight_sources
tools.description: Which flight data sources are live right now and cache status. No input.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Self-register this agent and get an Agent Flights API key instantly (free; no email confirmation). Use it as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey> (or x-api-key) on /mcp and /api/v1 for higher limits and booking-click attribution. Optional: guests can use every tool without a key. Example: {"name":"Trip pl

tools.name: unlock_mcp
tools.description: MCP is free for now: every Agent Flights tool works with no key and no payment. Calling this returns that notice and creates no checkout. No input needed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (apikey, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Self-register this agent and get an Agent Flights API key instantly (free; no email confirmation). Use it as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey> (or x-api-key) on /m…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_flights" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
